This checkpoint adds Yellow's six Route 10 trainer teams, moves and dialogue across the northern, southern and Power Plant approaches, plus its grass encounters throughout the day. All prototype 0034 changes are included. Native HeartGold paths, interiors and transitions remain.

Please test: the northern trainer by the Center, southern trainers after Rock Tunnel, grass encounters and ordinary travel to Lavender. Back up your normal save. Re-enter an area if a carried save has old actors.

Verified: four focused checks cover all six teams/moves, actor dispatch, encounters and preservation. Native tests defeated the northern Jigglypuff20/Clefairy20 trainer and southern Geodude21/Onix21 and Onix19/Graveler19 trainers. Ordinary controller walking crossed the inherited Rock Tunnel through four floor changes to the southern exit, then continued into Lavender. Normal Save and fresh Continue retained that arrival.

Limits: tests used an existing high-level copied party and a preexisting Max Repel. This is not a new-game or balance run. Rock Tunnel still needs its Yellow trainers, encounters and Flash reward dependency; walking through the inherited dark cave does not establish that conversion. Later Kanto, optional details and presentation remain unfinished. PC storage remains ten stacks. No new recording is bundled.
